contexts: An image editor where third-party and AI-powered tool packs (background removal, generative fill, upscaling, face retouching) are installed into user-arranged workspaces, and the product must guarantee that generative tools never appear in a 'forensic / documentary' workspace and always show provenance.

A node-based colour-grading application where a 'film emulation' pack must enforce that its nodes come after the input colour-space transform and before the output transform, and where an assistant agent can author new node layouts.

questions.q1: Why must passes be pure checks, and what does the originating project do when a pass throws?
questions.q2: Why is the rule 'a viewer listing the finish tools needs the finish kit' installed on the shell rather than in the finish kit?
questions.q4: When should a pass warn rather than error, according to the chapter?
questions.q5: How many passes does the originating project's finish kit install in total, and what is the CB code of the third one?
